IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair
sits on a dark wooden chest against a deep teal
backdrop. She wears a burgundy lace cardigan
over a burgundy corset bodice with a plunging
neckline and lace trim. A pendant on a fine chain
rests at her chest. Dark trousers and tall brown
leather boots complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, low-key studio light with
gentle falloff. Palette of burgundy, deep teal, and
warm brown. Dark romantic and editorial, in the
style of a fine-art portrait.
